'''Georgy Feodosevich Voronoy''' ({{langx|ru|Георгий Феодосьевич Вороной}}; {{langx|uk|Георгій Феодосійович Вороний}}; 28 April 1868 – 20 November 1908) was an Imperial Russian mathematician of [[Ukrainians|Ukrainian]] descent noted for defining the [[Voronoi diagram]].<ref>{{cite journal
 | last=Voronoï
 | first=Georges
 | year=1908a
 | title=Nouvelles applications des paramètres continus à la théorie des formes quadratiques. Premier mémoire. Sur quelques propriétés des formes quadratiques positives parfaites.
 | journal=Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik
 | volume=1908
 | issue=133
 | pages=97–178
 | doi=10.1515/crll.1908.133.97
 | s2cid=116775758
 | url=https://gdz.sub.uni-goettingen.de/download/pdf/PPN243919689_0133/LOG_0010.pdf
}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal
 | last=Voronoï
 | first=Georges
 | year=1908b
 | title=Nouvelles applications des paramètres continus à la théorie des formes quadratiques. Deuxième mémoire. Recherches sur les parallélloèdres primitifs.
 | journal=Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik
 | volume=1908
 | issue=134
 | pages=198–287
 | doi=10.1515/crll.1908.134.198
 | s2cid=118441072
 | url=https://gdz.sub.uni-goettingen.de/download/pdf/PPN243919689_0134/LOG_0014.pdf
}}</ref>

==Biography==
Voronoy was born in the village of [[:uk:Журавка_(Прилуцький_район)|Zhuravka]], [[Pyriatyn]], in the [[Poltava Governorate]], which was a part of the [[Russian Empire]] at that time and is in Varva Raion, [[Chernihiv Oblast]], [[Ukraine]].

Beginning in 1889, Voronoy studied at [[Saint Petersburg State University|Saint Petersburg University]], where he was a student of [[Andrey Markov]]. In 1894 he defended his master's thesis ''On algebraic integers depending on the roots of an equation of third degree''.  In the same year, Voronoy became a professor at the [[University of Warsaw]], where he worked on [[continued fraction]]s. In 1897 he defended his doctoral thesis ''On a generalisation of a continuous fraction''. He was an Invited Speaker of the [[International Congress of Mathematicians|ICM]] in 1904 at [[Heidelberg University|Heidelberg]].<ref>{{cite book|chapter=''Sur une propriété du discriminant des fonctions entières'' par G. Voronoy|pages=186–189|title=Verhandlungen des dritten Mathematiker-Kongresses in Heidelberg von 8. bis 13. August 1904|series=ICM proceedings|location=Leipzig|publisher=B. G. Teubner|year=1905|chapter-url=https://babel.hathitrust.org/cgi/pt?id=miun.aag4063.0004.001;view=1up;seq=202}}</ref>

When he was only 40 years of age, Voronoy began having stomach problems. He wrote in his diary:<ref>{{Cite web|last=O'Connor|first=J. J.|date=11 June 2020|title=Georgy Fedoseevich Voronoy|url=https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/Biographies/Voronoy/|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=11 June 2020|website=Mac Tutor - Math History}}</ref>

{{blockquote|text=I am making great progress with the question under study [indefinite quadratic forms]; however, at the same time my health is becoming worse and worse. Yesterday I had for the first time a clear idea of the algorithm in the theory of forms I am investigating, but also suffered a strong attack of bilious colic which prevented me from working in the evening and from sleeping the whole night. I am so afraid that the results of my enduring efforts, obtained with such difficulty, will perish along with me.}}

Following a severe gall bladder attack, Voronoy died on 20 November 1908.

[[Image:Voronyi_grivna.jpg|thumb|right|Two-[[Ukrainian hryvnia|hryvnia]] coin commemorating the centenary of Voronoy]]

==Works==

Voronoy introduced the concept of what we today call [[Voronoi diagrams]] or tessellations. They are used in many areas of science, such as the analysis of spatially distributed data, having become an important topic in [[geophysics]], [[meteorology]], [[condensed matter physics]], and [[Lie groups]].

These tessellations are widely used in many areas of computer graphics, from architecture to film making and video games. [[Blender 3D]] includes a Voronoi texture generator as one of its main sources of randomly generated images, that can be applied as textures for many different uses.

==Legacy==

Among his students was [[Wacław Sierpiński]] (Ph.D. at [[Jagiellonian University]] in 1906). Although he was not formally the doctoral advisor of [[Boris Delaunay]] ([[Doctor of Philosophy|Ph.D.]] at [[Taras Shevchenko National University of Kyiv|Kyiv University]]), his influence on the latter earns him the right to be considered so.<ref>{{cite book
| last1=Liebling | first1=Thomas
| last2=Pournin | first2=Lionel
| date=2012
| chapter=Voronoi diagrams and Delaunay triangulations: ubiquitous Siamese twins
| title=Optimization Stories
| series=Documenta Mathematica Series
| volume=ISMP
| pages=419–431
| doi=10.4171/DMS/6/40 | doi-access=free| isbn=978-3-936609-58-5
}}</ref>

In 2008 Ukraine released two-[[Ukrainian hryvnia|hryvnia]] coins commemorating the centenary of Voronoy's death.<ref>[http://bonnum.com/news/2008/ukr1_080808_ru.php Национальный банк Украины ввел в оборот монету “Георгий Вороной”] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110708082537/http://bonnum.com/news/2008/ukr1_080808_ru.php |date=2011-07-08 }}</ref>

==Family==

In 1895 he had a son with his wife Olga Mytrofanivna, named [[Yurii Voronyi]],<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Shevchuk |first1=Svitlana |last2=Zahorulko |first2=Anna |last3=Tretiak |first3=Mariia |title=ЮРІЙ ВОРОНИЙ. ІСТОРІЯ ХВОРОБИ ПЕРШОЇ ПАЦІЄНТКИ З ТРАНСПЛАНТАЦІЄЮ ТРУПНОЇ НИРКИ |journal=Actual Problems of Nephrology |date=2023 |issue=32–33 |pages=48–53 |doi=10.37321/nefrology.2023.32-33-06 |url=https://apn.org.ua/index.php/journal/article/view/70/54 |access-date=4 May 2025 |language=uk |issn=2707-9198|doi-access=free }}</ref> who became a prominent transplant surgeon who performed the world's first human-to-human kidney transplant in 1933,<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Matevossian |first1=Edouard |last2=Kern |first2=Hans |last3=Hüser |first3=Norbert |last4=Doll |first4=Dietrich |last5=Snopok |first5=Yurii |last6=Nährig |first6=Jörg |last7=Altomonte |first7=Jennifer |last8=Sinicina |first8=Inga |last9=Friess |first9=Helmut |last10=Thorban |first10=Stefan |title=Surgeon Yurii Voronyi (1895-1961) - a pioneer in the history of clinical transplantation: in memoriam at the 75th anniversary of the first human kidney transplantation |volume=22 |issue=12 |journal=Transplant International|publisher=Department of Surgery, Klinikum Rechts der Isar, Technische Universität of Munich, Munich, Germany. |date=December 2009 |pages=1132–1139 |doi=10.1111/j.1432-2277.2009.00986.x|pmid=19874569 |s2cid=12087935 }}</ref> volunteered for the army of [[Central Council of Ukraine]], and fought in the [[Battle of Kruty]].<ref>{{Cite web|date=2009-06-20|title=Офіційний сайт Херсонської обласної клінічної лікарні - спеціалізована медична допомога|url=http://www.oblhospital.com.ua/voronoi.php|access-date=2021-11-20|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090620064647/http://www.oblhospital.com.ua/voronoi.php|archive-date=2009-06-20}}</ref> His daughter Mariia Vorona-Vasylenko became a teacher of [[Ukrainian language]].<ref>{{Cite web|last=Черкаська|first=Ганна|date=2017-08-09|title=Діти Георгія Вороного|url=https://uahistory.com/topics/famous_people/8837|access-date=2021-11-20|website=UAHistory|language=uk}}</ref>
